intro_html: Bright lemon rice cooked in chicken broth, topped with garlicky browned turkey, briny olives, and crumbled feta. Each bowl brings 30 grams of protein for about $3.61 (at everyday cost). It tastes like a Greek taverna plate that somehow costs less than a gas station sandwich.
cost_closing_html: About $3.61 a bowl (at everyday cost) for the kind of lemon rice plate a Greek takeout counter charges $14 for, and theirs does not come with 13 more servings in the fridge.
shop_smart: The bottle of lemon juice covers the juice of about 7 lemons here for $1.30. Fresh lemons would run three times that, and the simmer hides the difference.
The 4 lb pack of 93/7 ground turkey beats the 1 lb trays on price per pound, and this recipe uses 3.75 lb of it, so there is almost no leftover to babysit.
Feta is the biggest line after the meat at $4.86. A block you crumble yourself usually beats the pre-crumbled tub per ounce.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Heat a splash of the olive oil in your biggest pot and cook the diced onion until soft, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add the ground turkey and break it up as it browns. Cook until it reaches 165F and no pink remains. Season with salt and pepper.
Stir in the rinsed rice, chicken broth, lemon juice, and enough water to cook the rice. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 15 to 18 minutes until the rice is tender.
Stir in the rest of the olive oil and the sliced olives, then taste for salt. Lemon rice should make your mouth water a little.
Portion into 14 containers and top each with crumbled feta.
portion_html: Weigh the full pot, subtract the empty pot number you wrote down, and divide by 14. Scoop that weight into each container and every bowl lands at about 567 calories and 30 grams of protein.

steps: Cook onion and garlic in olive oil, then brown the ground turkey to 165F.
Add rice, chicken broth, lemon juice, and water; cover and simmer until the rice is tender.
Stir in the remaining olive oil and sliced olives, then season.
Portion into 14 containers and top with crumbled feta.
